title: User-friendliness and ease of use
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on user-friendliness, with clear complaints about difficult interfaces or handles and several undetermined mentions that mix usability criticism with unrelated or ambiguous comments.

negative.summary: Negative reviews specifically describe the vehicle or door handles as not user-friendly and difficult to operate.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the system or process being less user-friendly, compare it unfavorably with another brand, or include an unrelated eco-friendly petrol usage comment.

limitations: Most examples are labeled undetermined, so the sentiment interpretation for the topic is limited.
